sentences.japanese: 君はできる限り早く家に帰った方がいい。
sentences.english: You'd better go home as soon as possible.

sentences.japanese: ここにいる限り安全です。
sentences.english: You are safe so long as you stay here.

sentences.japanese: 君の父の友達が父の味方だと限らない。
sentences.english: Your father's supporters are not limited to his friends.

sentences.japanese: 君のお父さんの友達がお父さんの味方だとは限らない。
sentences.english: Your father's supporters are not limited to his friends.

sentences.japanese: 君の限られた時間をできるだけうまく利用すべきだ。
sentences.english: You should make the best of your limited time.
